body:
Seen in the latest work run on task:10e5b94213c1e788. Four causes of wasted calls:

1. **False E0108 rename.** A patch that `Update`s one symbol and adds a method or function after unchanged context (steps 25, 27, 31) is refused as a rename of the updated symbol. Treat a new symbol after unchanged context as an add. When a patch is still refused, name the hunk and say to put the new symbol under its own `*** Add:` header. Don't point at `submit <name>` for a multi-symbol patch.
2. **Unknown header or target.** `*** Update: module:language::rust_refs` (step 73) answered only "is no symbol". For a `module:` prefix, a module name or a source path, answer with the form that works (`*** Update: <module>`, per `help submit`). A path `read` of a source file (D-181) should name the symbol-reading command.
3. **Name syntax.** `view` of `extract.tests` versus `extract.tests::name`, and `.` versus `::`, failed 6 of 18 views in one call. When a name doesn't resolve, list the nearest stored names (same module, same leaf) in the error.
4. **Cascading errors.** One missing `pub(crate)` produced 20+ errors in step 44. When several errors have one cause (a private item used from another module, a missing method on a type), print one line naming the item and the fix and list the sites below it.

**Tests.** One unit test per cause: add-after-context applies; the `module:` header and unknown-name errors carry the hint; grouped privacy errors print one summary line.

**Left out:** the stale module text (task:800c50ca75a02efb) and the resumed-run summary.
title: submit: fewer false refusals, clearer errors
